The [[Imperial Dragon Bow]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[flatbow]] obtained from [[Azume]] in [[Kaineng Center]] after completion of [[The Final Confrontation]] in exchange for a [[Imperial Dragon's Tear]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage|Piercing Dmg]]: 15-28 (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
: Lengthens [[Poison]] [[duration]] on foes by 33% (Stacking)
: Health +30

==Replica==
It is possible to create an exact visual and technical replica for this item with:
*[[Imperial Bow]] from collector [[Shen Xi]]
*[[Poisonous]] [[Bow String]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Bow Grip]] [[of Fortitude]]

Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following flatbows:
**[[Feathered Flatbow]] from collectors [[Rahvu]], [[Pathfinder Alon]], or [[Pekk]] or crafters [[Aksah]], [[Asiri]], [[Hahbe]] or [[Kol Swordshanks]]
**[[Flatbow]] from collectors [[Ohtah]] or [[Guard Captain Mirkoz]]
**[[Destroyer Flatbow]] from crafter [[Balthor Coalforge]]
**[[Tormented Flatbow]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]
*Poisonous Bow String
*Perfect Bow Grip of Fortitude
OR
*One of the following flatbows:
**[[Feathered Flatbow]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
**[[Asuran Flatbow]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Flatbow]] from collector [[Zaishen Martial Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Flatbow]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Flatbow of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Norn Flatbow]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Flatbow]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Charr Flatbow]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Flatbow]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)

==Unique counterparts==
*[[Seedborn Flatbow]] has identical stats to this item.
*[[Destructive Hornbow]], [[Elswyth's Longbow]], [[Johon's Longbow]], [[Nundak's Recurve Bow]], [[Bow of the Kinslayer]], and [[Tenezel's Shortbow]] have stats identical to this item; however, they are different bow classes.
